title: Core sights
intro: Canonical Pass A backbone plus the local/crowd refinements that survived Pass B.

items.name: National Palace Museum
items.address: No. 221, Sec. 2, Zhishan Rd., Shilin Dist., Taipei
items.hours: Tue–Sun 09:00–17:00 after the Sep 13 trial period; 2026 special Monday opening includes Nov 9

items.name: Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall
items.hours: Memorial Hall 09:00–18:00; park 05:00–00:00, subject to official closure exceptions
items.why: Treat it as both monumental architecture and contested political history; the official museum contextualizes the authoritarian era and Taiwan's democratic transition.

items.name: Taipei 101 Observatory
items.why: Keep the first-trip must-see; Pass B improves the rest of the guide rather than deleting famous landmarks.

items.name: Yu Zai Fan Shu Tea House
items.hours: ⚠ Confirm directly on the day — no current T0 hours were verified in this harness
items.crowd_tip: Recent independent firsthand accounts describe it as calmer than the A-Mei queue next door; no menu price or operating-hour claim is borrowed from those posts.
items.why: The quieter-teahouse lead the intake asked Pass B to find.
